question: Will Anthropic have the best Math AI model at the end of July 2026?
rules:
This market will resolve according to the company that owns the model that has the highest arena rank based on the Chatbot Arena LLM Leaderboard (https://lmarena.ai/) when the table under the "Leaderboard" tab for "Math" is checked on July 31, 2026, 12:00 PM ET.

Results from the "Rank" column under the "Text Arena | Math" Leaderboard tab at https://arena.ai/leaderboard/text/math-no-style-control with style control off will be used to resolve this market.

Models will be ordered primarily by their leaderboard rank at the market’s check time. If two or more models are tied on rank, they will be ordered by their Arena score, including any underlying, unrounded, granular values reflected in the data below the leaderboard. If a tie still remains, alphabetical order of company names as listed in this market group will be used as a final tiebreaker (e.g., if the two models are tied by exact arena score, “Google” would be ranked ahead of “xAI”). This market will resolve based on the company that occupies first place under this ranking.

evidence.excerpt: The briefing is dated July 15, 2026, and identifies its data as current through July 16. Its pinned LMArena overall text snapshot with style control places Claude Fable 5 first at 1507.5, Muse Spark 1.1 second at 1493.1, and GPT-5.6 Sol X-High third at 1486.3. It says the published confidence intervals for Anthropic and Meta overlap.
Arena's July 16, 2026 changelog entry states that inkling and kimi-k3 were added to the Text Arena and Code Arena leaderboards.

OpenAI announced general availability of the GPT-5.6 family on July 9, including flagship Sol, Terra, and Luna. Its published academic evaluation table reports FrontierMath Tier 1–3 scores of 89% for Sol and 87% for Claude Fable 5, and Tier 4 scores of 83% for Sol and 87.8% for Fable 5.
Anthropic's June 9 announcement introduces Claude Fable 5 as a Mythos-class model made safe for general use. It also introduces Claude Mythos 5, with access restricted to approved organizations.

The Associated Press reported on July 1 that restrictions on Anthropic's latest Claude models had been lifted. Fable 5 was again widely available, while Mythos 5 access was restored only for a select group of approved U.S.-based organizations.
Arena's July 2, 2026 changelog entry states that claude-sonnet-5-thinking was added to the Code Arena, Text Arena, Search Arena, Vision Arena, and Document Arena leaderboards.

At Google's May 19 announcement, Gemini 3.5 Flash began rolling out as the first model in the Gemini 3.5 family. The Associated Press reported that Google was using Gemini 3.5 Pro internally and expected to launch it the following month.
